subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should `getPublishedDisplayManifest` become paginated, return a capped manifest with truncation metadata, or remain a documented complete-catalog exception?
rationale: The permanent consumer and API contract determines the correct implementation; source evidence cannot safely choose its response semantics or compatibility policy.

options.title: Paginate the manifest
options.body: Return bounded publisher-scoped pages and update consumers to request additional resources explicitly.

options.title: Cap with metadata
options.body: Preserve a single response while enforcing a documented maximum and clearly signaling a truncated catalog.

options.title: Document an exception
options.body: Keep the complete-catalog behavior intentionally and move any future redesign into a narrower canonical tracker.

recommendation.title: Paginate the manifest
recommendation.body: Return bounded publisher-scoped pages and update consumers to request additional resources explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue and staged implementation history and explicitly identified this contract as the remaining decision.
